brief_narrative:
Iberia Foods, a Spanish frozen-food manufacturer, wants a 12-week cost diagnostic and design program, run as twelve workstreams: procurement, manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, sales and marketing, pricing, finance, HR, IT, legal, real estate and customer service. It is an assessment only, no implementation support. The CFO, Marta Ruiz, and the COO sponsor it.

Their goal is to identify savings of 8% of the cost base without cutting service levels.

questions.text: Did Iberia Foods specify a format for the deliverable of the cost diagnostic and design program?

Has Iberia Foods excluded any areas or topics from the twelve workstreams?
